title: ESG research & analytics
summary: Combining stakeholder research and data analysis into a strategy proposal.
team: Matteo Paolini, Antoine De Poortere, Immaculée Houdegbe & Camille Dorie
overview: An academic client project with Arthur D. Little investigating ESG priorities and a proposed roadmap.
constraints: The analysis combines surveys, interviews and comparative research with different evidence strengths.
contribution: I contributed as part of the student team. This was an academic client project, not employment at Arthur D. Little.
approach: The work uses mixed research methods and a Python pipeline for survey preprocessing, descriptive analysis and visualization.
results: The team produced a report, executive summary and roadmap recommendations.
limits: The recommendations are project outputs rather than measured organizational impact. Public presentation uses aggregate findings, with individual survey and interview responses excluded.
